children: On August 28, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) due to its delayed Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The company has until October 27, 2026 to submit a compliance plan, and if accepted, Nasdaq may allow up to February 22, 2027 to regain compliance. The notice has no immediate effect on trading, though Nasdaq will display a noncompliance indicator.
